2026-10-03-guelph-toronto.summary: Toronto was shut out 46–0 at Varsity Stadium. Oskar McPhie recorded 7.5 tackles, Elijah Trench had 1.5 sacks, and Omar Martin rushed for 67 yards on 12 carries.

2026-10-03-queens-western.summary: Western lost 41–30 to Queen’s. The Mustangs had rallied with a 16–3 third quarter, including two Jerome Rancourt touchdown passes and a safety, before the Gaels finished ahead.

2026-10-03-laurier-waterloo.summary: Waterloo recovered after Laurier took a fourth-quarter lead. Rushing touchdowns from Owen Clarke and Brandon Riggan put the Warriors back in front, and Hayden Crowe broke up the final pass to secure the rivalry win.

2026-10-03-york-windsor.summary: Windsor defeated York 51–2 on Alumni Weekend. Kareame Cotton passed for 496 yards and five touchdowns, setting the school’s season touchdown-pass record with 23. York managed 38 yards of total offence.
